CFML Language Reference: Functions

DeleteClientVariable

Removes the named client variable from the current visitor's client storage. Assigning an empty string is not the same thing: the variable would still exist.

Category

System functions

Syntax

DeleteClientVariable("name")

Parameters

name
The name of the client variable, without the Client. prefix, in quotes.

Returns

YES if the variable existed and was deleted, NO otherwise.

Usage

Client management must be enabled with CFAPPLICATION CLIENTMANAGEMENT="Yes"; otherwise the function returns NO. Leave the read-only client variables (CFID, CFToken, HitCount and friends) alone; use GetClientVariablesList to see the ones that are yours to delete.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFAPPLICATION NAME="SnippetClientDemo" CLIENTMANAGEMENT="Yes" CLIENTSTORAGE="Cookie">
<CFSET Client.FavoriteColor = "Teal">
<CFSET Client.ModemSpeed = "28.8">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Before: #GetClientVariablesList()#
<P>DeleteClientVariable("ModemSpeed") returned #DeleteClientVariable("ModemSpeed")#
(we upgraded to 56K).
<P>DeleteClientVariable("Pager") returned #DeleteClientVariable("Pager")#
<P>After: #GetClientVariablesList()#
<P>IsDefined("Client.ModemSpeed"): #IsDefined("Client.ModemSpeed")#
</CFOUTPUT>
